regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: DOS EXE header, rebuilt by the museum unpacker after removing the DIET compression.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 3 segment addresses that DOS patches with the real load address.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Fills the header to a 16-byte boundary.

regions.label: Small table
regions.note: Byte values at the start of his data.

regions.label: Pointers to the x values
regions.note: 10 word pointers, one per table row, 20 bytes apart.

regions.label: x values
regions.note: 10 numbers of 20 digits, one per result row.

regions.label: Pointers to the results
regions.note: 10 word pointers, 20 bytes apart.

regions.label: F(x) results
regions.note: 10 numbers of 20 digits.

regions.label: Variables
regions.note: Flags, pointers and the overflow flag at DS:01E1.

regions.label: Formula text
regions.note: What you type, starting with an extra "(" so the whole formula is one bracket.

regions.label: Saved states
regions.note: The state byte before each typed character, so Backspace can step back.

regions.label: State byte
regions.note: DS:0282, one bit per kind of key allowed next. It starts as 2Eh.

regions.label: Blank line
regions.note: Spaces and a $, used to clear the input line.

regions.label: Prompt pointers
regions.note: Two pointers to the "initial value" and "final value" prompts.

regions.label: Prompts
regions.note: "Enter the intial value ----->  X =", the final value prompt, the table title and "* OVERFLOW *".

regions.label: Plain copy of the credit
regions.note: "Yasser Dot Design.." and "<c>1992 YASSER MOHAMED ALI." in plain text. The credit on screen comes from the scrambled copy in the code.

regions.label: Error pointers
regions.note: 8 pointers to the error messages.

regions.label: Error messages and table header
regions.note: "Bad end of the formula", "Error in number of praces", "Out of accurecy scope" and the column titles.

regions.label: Work area
regions.note: Zeros in the file: number buffers (x at DS:0567, operands at 057B and 058F) and the formula as a list of 20-digit numbers and operators.

regions.label: Textbook start
regions.note: push ds / mov ax,0 / push ax, then DS = the data segment.

regions.label: Curtain effect
regions.note: Scrolls the screen open with BIOS INT 10h, one line at a time.

regions.label: Exit and set-up
regions.note: The exit path, and the screen set-up before typing.

regions.label: Key filter
regions.note: Reads keys and accepts only those whose bit is set in DS:0282; Backspace, Enter and Esc.

regions.label: Screen helpers
regions.note: Cursor and message printing.

regions.label: Number reader
regions.note: Turns typed text into a 20-digit fixed-point number (up to 7 integer digits).

regions.label: Run-once block 1
regions.note: Patches 5 bytes of the scrambled credit, then writes RET over its own first byte.

regions.label: Table loop
regions.note: Reads the first and last x and works out each row.

regions.label: Ten's complement
regions.note: Negates a number: 9 minus each digit, then + 1.

regions.label: Carry pass
regions.note: One DIV 10 per digit, right to left.

regions.label: Formula set-up
regions.note: Prepares the formula for one x value.

regions.label: Add
regions.note: Digit-by-digit addition, then the carry pass.

regions.label: Multiply
regions.note: Long multiplication: 20 by 20 digits into 40.

regions.label: Divide
regions.note: Repeated subtraction; a quotient digit may reach 250 before a carry pass.

regions.label: Find the innermost bracket
regions.note: Recursive: calls itself for each "(".

regions.label: Run-once block 2
regions.note: Unscrambles the credit: each byte minus the stored byte before it.

regions.label: Evaluate one bracket
regions.note: * and / first, then + and -.

regions.label: Scrambled credit
regions.note: 54 bytes inside the code that become "Yasser Dot Design.. <c>1992 YASSER MOHAMED ALI." at run time.

regions.label: Write a result into the formula
regions.note: Copies a result string back into the formula text.

regions.label: Run-once block 3
regions.note: Adds up the code from 035E and adds A517h to the exit jump at 0F13.

regions.label: Number helpers
regions.note: Copy and compare 20-digit numbers.

regions.label: Credit writer
regions.note: Writes the unscrambled credit straight into video memory, then returns into the exit.

regions.label: Results and errors
regions.note: Prints the result table and the error messages.

regions.label: Patched exit jump
regions.note: Stored as E9 00 00; block 3 turns it into E9 45 FD (to 0C5B).

regions.label: After the exit jump
regions.note: Where the stored jump of zero bytes leads; block 3 sends the exit to his credit instead.

regions.label: Closing RETF
regions.note: Closes his main procedure.

routines.name: key_filter
routines.note: Ignores every key whose bit is off in the state byte.

lines.note: A point needs bit 40h and no 80h
After a digit: keep "point seen", allow ) digit op - .
Save the old state for Backspace
RET over its own first byte
This byte minus the previous one

routines.name: checksum_patch
routines.note: Run-once checksum that repairs the exit jump.

lines.note: Add the result into the jump at 0F13
